campaign_name: PR-BR Continuation 26 — Contract Sufficiency and Post-Contract Semantic Closure
purpose: Close post-contract family reinterpretation, incoherent social proposals, and raw structured envelopes. PR-BR stays open.
executive_summary: Resolver selection now reads construction.resolution_subject and no longer re-reads the utterance. Structured envelopes are rejected before sealing. Historical C12-C25 suites passed, and the D, J, R, S, and T matrices passed. The four-turn live session kept a contract on every turn and leaked no JSON, but turns 3 and 4 still labeled addressed speech that mentioned shelter as place_location. Manual review was 2/4. Decision: C26 incomplete, interpretation coherence remains unsafe. No 4x10 gate. No human playtest. No commit.

production: game/contract_adjudication_bridge.py derives resolution_subject during contract construction and selects the adjudication family from that subject.
game/ordinary_semantic_ownership.py selects social, exploration, travel, world action, combat, or generation from the subject.
game/interpretation_proposal.py canonicalizes or abstains when a proposal contradicts addressed speech.
game/structured_player_output.py and game/gm.py extract player-facing text or reject a structured envelope.
game/immutable_valid_response.py rejects a structured envelope as player-facing text.
validation: tests/test_pr_br_continuation26_semantic_closure.py covers D1-D8, J1-J6, R1-R20, S1-S10, and T1-T10.
tooling: artifacts/pr_br_continuation26/run_live.py runs at most four live turns in one isolated session.

testing.focused: C26 matrices passed: D 8/8, J 6/6, R 20/20, S 10/10, T 10/10.
testing.broader: C12-C25 modules passed. Nearby, local-presence, and earshot tests passed except the pre-existing question-rule unit test.
testing.runtime_validation: 4 completed live turns. 1 interpretation invocation. 2 gameplay generations. 0 retries. No smoke. No 4x10. No repair rerun.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: 1 interpretation invocation. 2 initial gameplay generations. 0 retries. 0 evaluator calls. 4 player-model calls. 1 opening generation.
testing.new_regressions: Live turns 3 and 4 selected place_location for addressed speech that mentioned shelter. Not patched after the session.
testing.pre_existing_failures: test_question_rule_does_not_rewrite_resolved_place_existence, already red for C24 and C25.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Whether the next cycle should treat addressed quoted speech as social before any place subject, and whether the 240-character contract window must keep the terminal ask.

campaign_specific: Quoted speech that mentions shelter can still become resolution_subject place_location.
The contract keeps 240 characters, so a trailing ask can fall outside the subject decision.

missing_concepts: A structural speech-span check that outranks place tokens while the subject is being derived.
A contract text window that does not drop the terminal clause.
does_not_prove: It does not prove the second 4x10 gate would pass.
It does not prove addressed speech is immune to a place subject.
It does not authorize human playtest or PR-BS.
recommended_next_step: External review. Do not open C27, do not run the 4x10 gate, and do not patch the live place-subject failure from this session.

supporting_files.why: Subject derivation and contract-only family selection.
D, J, R, S, and T matrices.
